_comment: Single tradeable universe for train eval, live panel, arena, manifests, paper. Helios Phase 0: fail-closed liquidity. Bare U/R removed from exclude_suffixes (they banned MU/KR); units are length>=4 ending U in code. Spread and yacht market-cap gates apply only when those fields exist — they are never invented. Missing close/ADV/vol_20 = not tradeable.
spread_gate_note: max_spread_bps is skipped when no bid/ask or spread_bps is on the shard — do not invent a spread.
market_cap_gate_note: yacht_tier_min_market_cap_usd is skipped when marketCap is absent on the shard — do not invent a cap.
